parent_models.justification: BART (Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers) is known as a transformer-based generative model, making "generative model" a parent model.

closest_child_model.justification: The model "vl-bart" is a direct extension or variant of the BART model, thereby being the closest in terms of specific implementation.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Both "BART" and "concept-bert" are designed for natural language processing tasks, making them closely related as siblings, especially in the context of leveraging transformers.
